Normal authority basis: Security Analyst coordinates detection and initial triage
Emergency or exception note: Escalate immediately if active harm or material impact is suspected
Required record: Source time initial facts evidence references and triage status

Normal authority basis: Security Analyst owns analysis and uncertainty reporting
Emergency or exception note: Request external analysis if internal capability or independence is insufficient
Required record: Hypotheses evidence references scope assessment and unresolved questions

Normal authority basis: Incident Response Lead declares under Stage 1 authority
Emergency or exception note: Delegated senior IT/security decision-maker may declare if IRL is unavailable and delegation is recorded
Required record: Incident ID evidence basis initial severity owner delegation and next review

Normal authority basis: Incident Response Lead activates required response functions
Emergency or exception note: Deputy or management-appointed incident director acts only within recorded authority
Required record: Activation scope resources communication route and review point

Normal authority basis: Incident Response Lead escalates with management notification
Emergency or exception note: Senior Management may direct a higher tier; reassess on material evidence or impact change
Required record: Evidence impact urgency uncertainty authority notification and reassessment basis

Normal authority basis: Incident Response Lead authorises normal containment and IT Operations executes
Emergency or exception note: Emergency path is separate in R07; technical operator cannot expand scope
Required record: Approved target scope expected effect evidence plan business impact and review time

Normal authority basis: IT Operations Lead is accountable only for the constrained emergency authority when IRL cannot be reached promptly and delay may materially worsen harm
Emergency or exception note: Formal delegated senior IT/security authority may substitute and must be recorded; retrospective management review required
Required record: Why delay was unsafe minimum action authority delegation notification evidence effect business impact and review deadline

Normal authority basis: Digital Forensics and Evidence Custodian coordinates evidence preservation within approved scope
Emergency or exception note: If disruptive containment is urgent record unavoidable evidence loss and seek specialist support
Required record: Provenance collection status custody references secure storage and limitations

Normal authority basis: Communications Coordinator owns preparation and coordination; Senior Management retains release approval
Emergency or exception note: Use verified phone fallback when email trust is unverified; do not release unapproved external messages
Required record: Draft message audience channel approval reference facts and notification time WAT

Normal authority basis: Privacy or Legal Adviser owns the advisory assessment
Emergency or exception note: No jurisdiction or deadline is assumed; formal notification approval remains with authorised management
Required record: Advice basis jurisdiction or contract question factual uncertainty approval recommendation and deadline source if verified

Normal authority basis: Security Analyst owns the security validation while IT and forensics perform checks
Emergency or exception note: No restoration from an unvalidated backup; obtain specialist support where required
Required record: Validation method evidence references integrity and recoverability limitations and decision recommendation

Normal authority basis: Senior Management retains material activation and institutional risk acceptance; BCC coordinates authorised arrangements
Emergency or exception note: Predefined low-risk preparations may proceed within written delegation; material deviation requires management approval
Required record: Trigger authority delegation continuity option security restrictions approval and review condition

Normal authority basis: Business Service Owner approves examination delivery within approved parameters
Emergency or exception note: Senior Management approves material deviation or institutional risk acceptance; BCC cannot override security restrictions
Required record: Learner impact technical prerequisites security assumptions approval communications and review condition

Normal authority basis: IT Operations Lead authorises technical restoration work subject to security and business gates
Emergency or exception note: High/Critical management approval is represented through R20 where material risk or exception exists; no unsafe emergency restoration
Required record: Restoration scope prerequisites approvals execution status and technical test result

Normal authority basis: Security Analyst owns security validation and does not certify cleanliness without evidence
Emergency or exception note: Further investigation or external specialist support is required if validation is incomplete
Required record: Security validation evidence persistence or access findings restrictions and decision

Normal authority basis: IT Operations owns technical data-integrity verification with evidence and forensic support
Emergency or exception note: Unvalidated backup or inconsistent application state blocks safe return
Required record: Files application state permissions recovery data checks evidence and limitations

Normal authority basis: Business Service Owner accepts service return after technical security and integrity gates
Emergency or exception note: Senior Management accepts material continuity risk or deviation; technical execution alone is insufficient
Required record: Business readiness learner impact conditions approval and review point

Normal authority basis: Incident Response Lead owns closure recommendation and review coordination
Emergency or exception note: Management or appointed closure authority must approve where required; unresolved risks remain open
Required record: Closure authority records communications follow-up owners unresolved risks and review outcome

Normal authority basis: Incident Response Lead approves limited deviation within delegated authority
Emergency or exception note: Material impact or weakened controls escalate to R20; document rationale and review condition
Required record: Deviation scope rationale compensating control authority duration and review

Normal authority basis: Senior Management or Executive Sponsor owns institutional risk acceptance
Emergency or exception note: Emergency protective action may proceed only to reduce immediate harm and must receive retrospective management review
Required record: Exception scope consultation risk acceptance compensating controls approval and review deadline

Normal authority basis: Incident Response Lead delegates defined response decisions within policy authority
Emergency or exception note: No onward delegation unless expressly permitted; emergency authority remains constrained
Required record: Recipient scope start time WAT expiry or review restrictions approval reference and revocation

Activity: Appointment of incident leadership or continuity deputy
Normal authority basis: Senior Management or Executive Sponsor appoints replacement incident leadership or BCC deputy
Emergency or exception note: Incident Response Lead or BCC cannot self-appoint the management-designated deputy
Required record: Appointment authority role scope effective time WAT expiry or review and communication to affected teams
